git checkout -q -b perfproof/rolling-sum && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
s=open('rolling.py').read()
i=s.index("    out = np.empty")
new='''    csum = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    np.cumsum(values, dtype=np.int64, out=csum[1:])
    return csum[width:] - csum[: n - width + 1]
'''
s=s[:i]+new
s=s.replace("Runs in O(n) time with a running total.","Runs in O(n) time with a prefix sum; int64 wraparound in the prefix\n    sums cancels in the difference, so exact window sums stay exact.")
open('rolling.py','w').write(s)
EOF
python -m pytest -q -m "not deliberately_flaky" 2>&1 | tail -3
python - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
from rolling import rolling_sum
import subprocess,sys
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
v=rng.integers(0,1000,5000,dtype=np.int64)
ref=np.array([v[i:i+3000].sum() for i in range(2001)])
print(np.array_equal(rolling_sum(v,3000),ref))
EOF
git commit -qam "rolling_sum: prefix-sum instead of per-element loop
